candidates.evidence: Strong A1g-type band at 197.1 cm-1 and weaker Eg band at 149.9 cm-1, with a ratio of about 9:1. Both match literature 1T-HfSe2 values (Eg ~145-150, A1g ~199-200 cm-1). The only other strong line is the Si substrate.
Same structure type, but its A1g sits near 195 cm-1 and Eg near 145 cm-1. Not fully excluded by position alone. The Eg is slightly high for ZrSe2, so HfSe2 is preferred.
A1g is near 185 cm-1 and Eg near 108 cm-1, which does not match the observed 197/150 pair.

peaks.source: Lorentzian fit of this work. Mode assignment from literature on 1T-HfSe2 Raman (A1g ~199 cm-1).
Lorentzian fit of this work (amplitude ~1150 counts over a ~270-count noise). Mode assignment from literature on 1T-HfSe2 Raman (Eg ~145-150 cm-1).
First-order Si optical phonon at ~520.7 cm-1 from the SiO2/Si substrate.

properties.name: phase
properties.source: Mode positions match the 1T polytype of HfSe2. Group theory gives two Raman-active modes, Eg and A1g.

properties.name: layers
properties.source: A1g/Eg intensity ratio and linewidths alone do not fix thickness. No low-frequency shear or breathing modes were resolved.

properties.name: defect_level
properties.source: Narrow A1g (3.7 cm-1 FWHM), no extra bands, and no visible oxide or HfSe2 disorder features.

citations: Literature on 1T-HfSe2 Raman: Eg ~145-150 cm-1 and A1g ~199-200 cm-1 (cited from memory, not checked against the papers)
Si first-order phonon at 520.7 cm-1 (standard reference value)
limits: Only two sample peaks are above the noise (~270 counts rms). The other local maxima are noise-level and are not reported.
The substrate second-order Si band (~300 cm-1) and the SiO2 features are not clearly resolved.
The measurement is unpolarized or has no angle resolution, so peak symmetry patterns cannot be classified.
Layer number is not determined. Strain and doping cannot be determined without a reference peak position.
Identification rests on two mode positions. ZrSe2 cannot be fully excluded without the position of an additional feature, though the Eg position favours HfSe2.
The literature values are cited from memory, so the exact ranges may differ slightly.
